paper_title: Near-quantum-limited axion dark matter search with the ORGAN experiment around 26 $μ$eV
notes: ORGAN-Q (Oscillating Resonant Group AxioN - Quantum phase) reports the most sensitive exclusion limits on axion-photon coupling in the 25.45–26.27 μeV (6.15–6.35 GHz) mass range. The limit |g_agamma| ≳ 2.8×10^-13 at 95% CL is stated in the abstract and conclusion. The experiment is a haloscope using a conducting rod resonator in a 7-T solenoidal magnet with a flux-driven Josephson parametric amplifier (JPA) for near-quantum-limited noise performance. Data acquisition covered ~17 days with 489 resonant frequencies scanned. The local dark matter density of 0.45 GeV/cm³ is explicitly assumed (Eq. 3 and text). The coupling limit is approximately flat across the scanned mass range, so encoded as a two-point horizontal line at the mass boundaries. Fractional uncertainty in g_agamma is 6.3%, dominated by uncertainties in system noise temperature (11.6%) and form factor (5%). | selector: text (sole candidate)
